name: lemeng.retail.day.backfill

data.label: whoami 身份探针（xml + raw 落原件）
抠出全部 SSE data: 行
取最后一条 + 拆 JSON-RPC 外壳（对齐 wrapper 的 m[-1]）

properties.sql: SELECT json_extract_string(line, '$.result.content[0].text') AS txt FROM input QUALIFY row_number() OVER () = count(*) OVER ()

data.label: 取身份事实 company_id / branch_nums

properties.sql: SELECT json_extract_string(txt, '$.company_id') AS company_id, json_extract_string(txt, '$.branch_nums') AS branch_nums FROM input

data.label: 反向闸：抠不出身份 ⇒ 红（挡网关形状漂移）

properties.message: identity: whoami 响应里没有可解析的身份（网关形状变了？）⇒ 身份未证，拒绝采集与写湖

data.label: 两条断言：① 账套 ② 配置门店 ⊆ 可见门店

properties.sql: SELECT 'book' AS violation, company_id AS detail FROM input WHERE company_id IS DISTINCT FROM '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' UNION ALL SELECT 'branch' AS violation, CAST(c.branch_num AS VARCHAR) AS detail FROM (SELECT unnest('${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}'::BIGINT[]) AS branch_num) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT unnest(CAST(json_extract(branch_nums, '$[*]') AS BIGINT[])) AS branch_num FROM input) w USING (branch_num) WHERE w.branch_num IS NULL

data.label: 有违规行 ⇒ 红；其后才 trigger 采集（先证后采）

properties.message: identity: 凭据账套/门店清单自证未过 ⇒ 拒绝采集与写湖

data.label: Assert expected-value shapes

properties.sql:
SELECT 'BRANCH_NUMS' AS violation, '${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}' AS detail, 'JSON integer array, e.g. [1001,1002]' AS rule
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}', '\[[0-9]+([, ]+[0-9]+)*\]')
UNION ALL SELECT 'SYSTEM_BOOK', '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}', 'digits only'
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}', '[0-9]{1,32}')
UNION ALL SELECT 'BIZDAY', '${BIZDAY}', 'YYYY-MM-DD（回填参数；由驱动脚本按 bizday 逐日传入）'
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${BIZDAY}', '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
UNION ALL SELECT 'RUN_TOKEN', t.tok, 'YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ'
FROM (SELECT replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z' AS tok) t
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match(t.tok, '[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z')
UNION ALL SELECT 'BATCH_ID', x.bid, 'retail-<book>-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ-day'
FROM (SELECT 'retail-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-' || replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z-day' AS bid) x
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match(x.bid, 'retail-[0-9]+-[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-day')
UNION ALL SELECT 'DAY_SET', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) || '/' || min(b.bizday) || '-' || max(b.bizday), '1 row, bizday = ${BIZDAY}（回填）'
FROM (SELECT '${BIZDAY}' AS bizday) b
HAVING count(*) <> 1

data.label: Die on missing/malformed expected values

properties.message: EXPECTED_VALUE_MISSING_OR_MALFORMED: 期望值缺席或形状非法（{rows} 条违规，明细见上）⇒ 拒绝采集与写湖（等价于 wrapper 在 run-retail-day.sh:383/397 的 ASSERT_FAIL 硬失败）。处置：检查该管线调度/触发面的 env 注入

data.label: 窗口表（回填：${BIZDAY} 整天，恒 1 行）

properties.sql:
SELECT
  t.run_token AS run_token,
  '${BIZDAY}' AS bizday,
  '-' AS hour,
  '00:00:00' AS hour_from,
  '23:59:59' AS hour_to,
  '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  (SELECT branch_nums FROM input) AS branch_nums,
  'retail-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-' || replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z-day' AS batch_id
FROM (SELECT replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') AS run_token) t

data.label: 逐天跑整天重采子管线
窗口表 → 收据形状（status=pending）

properties.sql:
SELECT run_token AS run_token, system_book AS system_book, bizday AS bizday,
  hour AS hour, 0 AS "rows", 'pending' AS status
FROM input

data.label: 本 run 的窗口清单落盘（收据目录的 schema 锚）
整批跑完再汇总
汇总每窗（收据 × 窗口表）

properties.sql:
SELECT w.hour AS hour, w.bizday AS bizday,
  w.run_token AS run_token,
  COALESCE(r."rows", 0) AS "rows",
  COALESCE(r.status, 'missing') AS status
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT hour, bizday, run_token FROM input) w
LEFT JOIN (SELECT hour, run_token, "rows", status
           FROM read_csv('/workspace/logs/retail-windows/*.csv', header = true, union_by_name = true)
           WHERE status = 'ok') r
  ON r.hour = w.hour AND r.run_token = w.run_token
ORDER BY w.hour

data.label: _ops 行成形（job=retail-window，wrapper ops_ship 同形：每天一行，缺口天也投）

properties.sql:
SELECT strftime(now(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS ts, 'retail-window' AS job, '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  bizday, hour, "rows", status, run_token FROM input

缺口窗（判红输入）

properties.message: WINDOWS_FAILED {rows} 窗未采到（system_book=${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}）⇒ 整批判红。⚠️ windows 形只采「上海昨天」、无回溯重放 ⇒ 被截掉的尾窗**必须当日补跑**（本 run 的 checkpoint 会让补跑只发缺页数个请求）；缺口明细见 /workspace/logs/retail-windows-summary.csv

data.label: 现算门店清单 = whoami可见 − BRANCH_EXCLUDE（#793 新店自动纳入）

properties.sql:
SELECT company_id,
       to_json(list_filter(CAST(json_extract(branch_nums, '$[*]') AS BIGINT[]),
              x -> NOT list_contains(CAST('${ENV:BRANCH_EXCLUDE}' AS BIGINT[]), x))) AS branch_nums
FROM input

data.label: 现算清单为空守卫（foreach 零 item = 静默空转）

properties.sql:
SELECT 'computed_branch_list_empty' AS violation, company_id AS detail
FROM input WHERE json_array_length(branch_nums) = 0

data.label: 现算清单空 ⇒ 判红

properties.message: computed: whoami 现算门店清单为空（visible − BRANCH_EXCLUDE）⇒ foreach 零 item = 静默空转（#793）⇒ 拒绝采集与写湖

data.label: BRANCH_EXCLUDE 形状闸

properties.sql:
SELECT 'BRANCH_EXCLUDE' AS violation, '${ENV:BRANCH_EXCLUDE}' AS detail, 'JSON integer array, [] or [99,100]' AS rule
WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${ENV:BRANCH_EXCLUDE}', '\[\s*\]|\[\s*[0-9]+(\s*,\s*[0-9]+)*\s*\]')

data.label: BRANCH_EXCLUDE 非法 ⇒ 判红

properties.message: EXPECTED_VALUE_MISSING_OR_MALFORMED: BRANCH_EXCLUDE 缺席或形状非法（#793）⇒ 现算清单无法计算 ⇒ 拒绝采集与写湖。处置：console 服务 env 补 BRANCH_EXCLUDE（[] 或 [99] 形）

data.label: Assert bizday window closed (fail-closed, #528)

properties.sql:
SELECT 'WINDOW_OPEN' AS violation,
       '${BIZDAY}' AS detail,
       '上海时间未到次日 00:00：回填将窗内抓拍并被 checkpoint 永久冻结（#528），拒绝' AS rule
WHERE (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < ('${BIZDAY}'::date + INTERVAL 1 DAY)

data.label: Die if bizday not closed

properties.message: WINDOW_OPEN: bizday=${BIZDAY} 尚未闭窗（上海时间未到次日 00:00），回填会抓到截断快照并被 checkpoint 永久冻结（#528）⇒ fail-closed 拒绝。处置：等上海时间过了该 bizday 次日 00:00 再回填

data.label: 反向漂移：现算 vs 底账（只告警不阻断）

properties.sql:
SELECT strftime(now(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS ts, 'retail-window' AS job, '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
       '-' AS bizday, 'drift' AS hour, count(*) AS "rows", 'config_drift' AS status,
       replace('${datetime}', '-', '') AS run_token,
       string_agg(CASE WHEN w.b IS NULL THEN '底账有现算无(排除或不可见): ' || CAST(c.b AS VARCHAR)
                       ELSE '现算有底账无(新店): ' || CAST(w.b AS VARCHAR) END, '；' ORDER BY 1) AS detail
FROM (SELECT unnest('${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}'::BIGINT[]) AS b) c
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT unnest(CAST(json_extract(i.branch_nums, '$[*]') AS BIGINT[])) AS b FROM input i) w
  ON c.b = w.b
WHERE c.b IS NULL OR w.b IS NULL

data.label: 合流：窗口摘要 + 漂移告警（漂移 0 行时不贡献）

_note: lemeng.retail.day.backfill —— **回填专用**：整天重采某一天（参数驱动，可整批重跑）。
与 lemeng.retail.windows.l1 的差（三处，都有理由）：
① w0 的 bizday 取 **${BIZDAY}**（非 ENV 占位符，由驱动脚本经 POST /api/run 的 params 传入；
同一机制见 scripts/lemeng/backfill-retail-order-line.sh）。父管线那条只认「上海昨天」。
② 多一道 WINDOW_OPEN 闸（wc/dw，抄自 lemeng.retail.windows.backfill）：
子管线的 src.rest 是 `checkpoint: true` ⇒ 对**未闭窗**的日子回填会抓到截断快照并被
checkpoint 永久冻结（#528）⇒ fail-closed 拒绝，等过了次日 00:00 再来。
③ gv 的 BIZDAY / DAY_SET 断言改按 ${BIZDAY} 校验（父管线那条校验的是「昨天」）。
其余（身份自证、门店现算、收据、判红、封版标记）与父管线逐字同源 —— 它驱动的是同一条
排班：**不排**（EXEMPT_GLOBAL 已登记为回填专用）。
